title: anemone trifolia subsp. albida
intro: Anemone trifolia subsp. albida, commonly known as white wood anemone or white woodland anemone, is a perennial plant species belonging to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). This plant is known for its white flowers and is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including the relief of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Anemone trifolia subsp. albida include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with stress and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
